programme.title: Roadtrip With G. Garvin - Louisville
programme.desc: S2E6 - A visit to 610 Magnolia in Louisville, Ky., for slow-cooked oxtails; Hammerheads' eclectic menu; Juanita's Burger Boy Diner, serves classic diner fare; The Rudyard Kipling, known for burgoo, a meat and veggie stew. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Eatin' OK in the OKC
programme.desc: S5E12 - Ali Khan's day of deliciousness starts with tiramisu pancakes; an authentic, crispy Cuban sandwich. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Eating Vermont
programme.desc: S3E13 - Ali kicks things off in Burlington, VT, with a local favorite, the unique bacon maple wafflini; he hits up a lunch counter that's been around since the 1940s; Ali tries the Macho Man, a sandwich that mashes together a Reuben and patty melt. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Queen City Cravings
programme.desc: S5E5 - Sweet and satisfying slowberry cobbler waffle; a food truck that's serving up mouthwatering sliders that are too good to try only one; a decadent French Pot de Crème; ramen gumbo that's packed with a fusion of flavor. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Cream of the Crop
programme.desc: S2E9 - Ali begins his day in Louisville, Ky., by cutting into a towering stack of hot chocolate pancakes; a saucy Mata Hari hot brown; apple brandied pie; Southern fried chicken and sweet potato waffles. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Santa Barbara Bargains
programme.desc: S4E10 - Ali Khan is in Santa Barbara, Calif. Looking for the best deals for breakfast, lunch, dinner and a snack; he gets off to a pricey start with a bacon and egg breakfast sandwich on a buttery brioche that's worth every penny. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Mealin' and Dealin' in Michigan
programme.desc: S5E3 - Ali Khan chows down in Ann Arbor, Mich., starting with a heaping helping of deep-fried French toast covered in berries and whipped cream; blackened mackerel with a Thai chili glaze at a super fresh seafood market. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Decadent Regional Dishes
programme.desc: S2E6 - In Baton Rouge, La., chef Jay Ducote introduces a French and Cajun-inspired burger; in St. Louis, toasted ravioli stuffed with burnt ends; in Austin, Texas, a gigantic peach-glazed pork chop and peanut butter mousse pie. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Super Chefs' Favorite Foods
programme.desc: S2E8 - Football legend, Earl Campbell, digs into brisket and peach cobbler at one of Texas' most famous barbecue restaurants; in Cincinnati, a bacon and blue cheeseburger; in Kansas City, Mo., inside-out shepherd's pie and beer-infused doughnuts. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Juicy, Crunchy and Tangy
programme.desc: S2E9 - In Lexington, Ky., a plump pork burger and smoked chicken wings; spicy fried chicken and waffles that are making the Cincinnati food scene soar; Caribbean-inspired rum-soaked ribs in New Orleans. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Motor City's Mouthwatering Meats
programme.desc: S3E5 - Michael takes reality television star Kendra Wilkinson on a whirlwind food and beer tour of Detroit to introduce her to one of the country's most resurgent cities; enjoys microbrews, Coney Island dogs, spicy Korean sliders and pulled pork enchiladas. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Decadent D.C. Dining
programme.desc: S3E7 - Michael Symon and the winner of "Worst Cooks in America: Celebrity Edition," Jenni "JWoww" Farley, team up to tackle classic barbecue, fresh farmhouse burgers and microbrews; one of the area's best-known chefs gives his take on the local cuisine. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Smoking Meats and Summertime Eats
programme.desc: S4E7 - A whole pig on a super-sized indoor smoke pit; slow-smoked rib-eye steak sandwich complete with melted cheddar and caramelized onions; double beef patty burger that gets the royal treatment with two bacon grilled cheese sandwiches for buns. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Kyoto
programme.desc: S9E2 - Andrew explores the kaiseki multicourse meal and the comfort food obanzai of Kyoto, Japan. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Las Vegas
programme.desc: S8E9 - Andrew goes on a gastronomic tour of Las Vegas, from quail breast stuffed with foie gras and mouthwatering Wagyu steaks to classic veal Parmigiana and tantalizing Thai. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Genoa
programme.desc: S7E20 - Andrew looks at the inventive and time-honored eats of Genoa, Italy, home to big-league favorites like peasant-created seafood salad, pesto with pasta, and crispy, decadent flatbread. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - San Francisco: Second Bite
programme.desc: S10E13 - From Japanese hot pots and hand-crafted lasagna to ice cream made from locally sourced ingredients, Andrew explores San Francisco's culinary history and diversity for a second time. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Calabria
programme.desc: S10E19 - Andrew showcases Calabria, a rugged region in the toe of Italy's boot; Calabria sees a diverse range of ingredients that shine in signature dishes like fileja noodles with goat and parmigiana di melanzane. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - The Bronx
programme.desc: S10E1 - Andrew Zimmern explores the international flavors of the Bronx, N.Y.; Italian-influenced bites; dry-aged pork sausage; spicy Jamaican meat pastries. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Unique Sweets - After School Favorites
programme.desc: S2E6 - After school favorites that break all the traditional rules and win. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Unique Sweets - Breakfast Pastries
programme.desc: S2E7 - Unique breakfast pastries from Oregon, California, New York and Connecticut. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Unique Sweets - Morning munchies
programme.desc: S6E14 - Unique ways to add fruits and veggies to your morning meal with a tropical breakfast bruschetta; blue corn zucchini bread; strawberry mint hand pie. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Unique Sweets - Next Level Sweets
programme.desc: S6E15 - Sampling cutting-edge sweet creations; coconut cremeaux at The Pig and The Lady in Honolulu; whole vanilla bean ice cream by the creator of the Cronut in New York City; raspberry ice box cake at Sweet Lulu's Bakery on Wheels in Charleston. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Unique Sweets - Sweet Twists on American Classics
programme.desc: S7E1 - The Doughnut Project in New York City offers a chocolate cream doughnut flavored with bone marrow; Sweetness Bake Shop in Miami offers a cinnamon-spice doughnut filled with dulce de leche and topped in chocolate frosting and a crispy churro. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Unique Sweets - Old Is New Again
programme.desc: S5E3 - Updating classic desserts; vegan cupcakes in Austin, Texas; resurrecting vintage cake recipes in Los Angeles. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.desc: S1E5 - A husband-and-wife-owned truck in Los Angeles that is winning over Californians with crêpes; a taste of Indian street food in North Carolina; a larger-than-life hot dog cart that's putting a delicious spin on the American classic. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Paradise - Extreme Eats
programme.desc: S14E40 - A 15-pound bloody Mary, a palatial pizza made of chicken Parmesan and more. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Street Eats

Reilly, Alec Baldwin (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. - Jackie Chan, Pierce Brosnan, Ray Fearon, Orla Brady, Tao Liu (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: In Mexico City, a newly modified liquid Terminator -- the Rev-9 model -- arrives from the future to kill a young factory worker named Dani Ramos. Also sent back in time is Grace, a hybrid cyborg human who must protect Ramos from the seemingly indestructible robotic assassin. But the two women soon find some much-needed help from a pair of unexpected allies -- seasoned warrior Sarah Connor and the T-800 Terminator. - Linda Hamilton, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Mackenzie Davis, Natalia Reyes, Gabriel Luna (Science fiction, Action)

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: After serving time in prison for taking the fall for a group of his friends, Leo just wants to get his life back on track. So he goes to the one place he thinks will be safe -- home. There he takes a new job with his highly connected and influential uncle. But in the yards, where his uncle now pulls the strings, safe is not how they do business. Unwittingly, he's drawn into a world of sabotage, high stakes payoffs and even murder. - Mark Wahlberg, Joaquin Phoenix, Charlize Theron, James Caan, Ellen Burstyn (Crime drama)

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: When retiring police Detective William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) tackles a final case with the aid of newly transferred David Mills (Brad Pitt), they discover a number of elaborate and grizzly murders. They soon realize they are dealing with a serial killer (Kevin Spacey) who is targeting people he thinks represent one of the seven deadly sins. Somerset also befriends Mills' wife, Tracy (Gwyneth Paltrow), who is pregnant and afraid to raise her child in the crime-riddled city. - Brad Pitt, Morgan Freeman, Gwyneth Paltrow, R. Lee Ermey, Richard Roundtree (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders. - Jordana Brewster, Clea DuVall, Laura Harris, Josh Hartnett, Shawn Hatosy (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery)

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: When a cockroach-spread plague threatens to decimate the child population of New York City, evolutionary biologist Susan Tyler (Mira Sorvino) and her research associates rig up a species of "Judas" bugs and introduce them into the environment, where they will mimic the diseased roaches and infiltrate their grubby habitats. So far so good ... until the bugs keep on evolving and learn to mimic their next prey -- humans. - Mira Sorvino, Jeremy Northam, Josh Brolin, Giancarlo Giannini, Charles S. Dutton (Horror, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Though well-meaning scientists thought they'd destroyed them all, a single gigantic, murderous Judas Breed cockroach, which is capable of taking on the shape of a human, is still on the loose. When the monster follows entomologist Remi Panos and kills her boyfriend, Jason Mundy, Remi becomes the prime suspect. Assigned to the case, detective Klaski grows convinced of her innocence and soon joins forces with her to hunt down the creature. - Alix Koromzay, Bruno Campos, Will Estes, Joseph Hodge, Jon Polito (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Mimic 3: Sentinel
programme.desc: Marvin (Karl Geary), who is hypersensitive to germs, stays inside taking photos of his neighbors, including a suspicious figure he dubs "The Garbageman" (Lance Henriksen) and a pretty woman named Carmen (Rebecca Mader). He lives with his mother (Amanda Plummer) and sister, Rosy (Alexis Dziena), who spends time with the local drug dealer. When people begin to disappear, Marvin starts playing detective, but he's soon in over his head when a mutant insect species known as the Judas Breed returns. - Karl Geary, Alexis Dziena, Keith Robinson, Rebecca Mader, Amanda Plummer (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Carriers
programme.desc: When a virus threatens to wipe out humanity, Danny (Lou Taylor Pucci), his brother Brian (Chris Pine), and their friends Bobby (Piper Perabo) and Kate (Emily VanCamp) set out across the desert in the Southwest, trying to elude the pandemic. Over the course of several days, the four friends learn that the darkness within themselves may prove deadlier than any microbe. - Lou Taylor Pucci, Chris Pine, Piper Perabo, Emily VanCamp, Christopher Meloni (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Vindicta
programme.desc: When a city is terrorized by a sadistic serial killer, a seasoned detective and a newly recruited paramedic are forced into a deadly game of vengeance, only to discover the key to stopping the bloodshed lies in unlocking the truth of their own pasts. - Elena Kampouris, Jeremy Piven, Sean Astin, Travis Nelson, Bradley Stryker (Thriller)

programme.title: The Autopsy of Jane Doe
programme.desc: When father and son coroners investigate the death of a beautiful "Jane Doe," they find increasingly bizarre clues. - Emile Hirsch, Brian Cox, Ophelia Lovibond, Michael McElhatton, Olwen Kelly (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. - Jackie Chan, Pierce Brosnan, Ray Fearon, Orla Brady, Tao Liu (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. - Rachel McAdams, Cillian Murphy, Brian Cox, Jayma Mays, Jack Scalia (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Run & Gun
programme.desc: After leaving a life of crime and violence, reformed good guy Ray enjoys a quiet family life in the suburbs. However, Ray's past comes back to haunt him as he gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has. - Ben Milliken, Brad William Henke, Janel Parrish, Mark Dacascos, Celestino Cornielle (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino. - David Arquette, Danny A. Abeckaser, Daniella Pick Tarantino, Dean Miroshnikov, Herzl Tobey (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune. - Jim Cummings, Jocelin Donahue, Sierra McCormick, Nicholas Logan, Michael Abbott Jr. (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: You Can Count on Me
programme.desc: Sammy is a single mother who is extremely protective of her 8-year-old son. She is satisfied with living in the small town she grew up in and working in a local bank. When her brother Terry visits he fits the void in the life of both her and her son. Temporarily free of the constraints of single motherhood she begins to break free of her normal routine. In a string of traumatic events Sammy is torn between helping her brother and her maternal instinct to protect her son from getting hurt. - Laura Linney, Mark Ruffalo, Rory Culkin, Matthew Broderick, Jon Tenney (Drama)

programme.title: Brave the Dark
programme.desc: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart. - Nicholas Hamilton, Jared Harris, Sasha Bhasin, Will Price, Jamie Harris (Drama)

programme.title: Nightwatch
programme.desc: A police inspector (Nick Nolte) suspects a law student (Ewan McGregor) or his friend (Josh Brolin) of serial killings and eerie events at the city morgue.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate a fortified church and destroy a Nazi transmitter. Making their way to an underground lab, the soldiers stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a battle against an army of the undead.

programme.title: The Spell
programme.desc: A dark spirit's quest for vengeance shatters a young couple's lives soon after they move into their new home.

programme.title: The Last Exorcism Part II
programme.desc: Unable to remember the horrific events of her past, Nell Sweetzer tries to rebuild her life in New Orleans. However, a demonic force soon returns with sinister plans for her.

programme.title: The Girl in the Pool
programme.desc: A man's life collapses when his mistress is found dead in his pool. Terrified of the consequences and desperate to protect his family, he conceals the truth, triggering a chaotic night that threatens to unravel his perfect life.

programme.title: Below
programme.desc: Mysterious events occur aboard a submarine after its crew (Matthew Davis, Bruce Greenwood) rescues three survivors from a sunken ship during World War II.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: When his new assignment goes awry, an elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him.

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: Seasoned warrior Sarah Connor joins forces with a hybrid cyborg human and the T-800 model to protect a young woman from the Rev-9 -- a newly modified and seemingly indestructible liquid Terminator from the future.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: After discovering a long-buried secret that jeopardizes what's left of society, a new Blade Runner embarks on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: The destruction of their shuttle leaves two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone and Matt Kowalski, stranded in space with no hope of rescue.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take
programme.desc: A psychiatrist's life gets turned upside down when a patient takes her own life, and he introduces her brother to his own family.

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: When retiring police Detective William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) tackles a final case with the aid of newly transferred David Mills (Brad Pitt), they discover a number of elaborate and grizzly murders. They soon realize they are dealing with a serial killer (Kevin Spacey) who is targeting people he thinks represent one of the seven deadly sins. Somerset also befriends Mills' wife, Tracy (Gwyneth Paltrow), who is pregnant and afraid to raise her child in the crime-riddled city. - Brad Pitt, Morgan Freeman, Gwyneth Paltrow, R. Lee Ermey, Richard Roundtree (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace; his actress wife, Mia; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge; master fixer The Wolf and a nervous pair of armed robbers, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny. - John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, Harvey Keitel, Tim Roth (Crime drama, Dark comedy)

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is. - Matthew Gray Gubler, AnnaLynne McCord, Alisha Boe, Sheila Vand, Sam Eidson (Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Thriller)

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government? - Steve Buscemi, Simon Russell Beale, Jeffrey Tambor, Paddy Considine, Rupert Friend (Dark comedy, Historical drama)

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. - Morgan Freeman, Monica Potter, Michael Wincott, Penelope Ann Miller, Michael Moriarty (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: The Core
programme.desc: Geophysicist Dr. Josh Keyes discovers that an unknown force has caused the Earth's inner core to stop rotating. With the planet's magnetic field rapidly deteriorating, our atmosphere literally starts to come apart at the seams with catastrophic consequences. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core. - Aaron Eckhart, Hilary Swank, Delroy Lindo, Stanley Tucci, D.J. Qualls (Action, Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: When the president (Carlos Estevez) of the United States has a mission that would be impossible for just any mortal man, the person he needs is Machete (Danny Trejo), a knife-wielding ex-Federale agent. Machete's mission is to take down Voz (Mel Gibson), a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has come up with a plot to start a nuclear war. Facing death at every turn from assassins, Machete pulls out all of his skills to get the job done. - Danny Trejo, Michelle Rodriguez, Sofía Vergara, Amber Heard, Antonio Banderas (Action)

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller. - Harrison Ford, Anne Archer, Patrick Bergin, Sean Bean, Thora Birch (Thriller, Action, Crime drama, Adventure, Mystery)

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated. - Fionn Whitehead, Tom Glynn-Carney, Jack Lowden, Harry Styles, Aneurin Barnard (War, Historical drama, Action)

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Ford Brody (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe (Bryan Cranston). Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco. - Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Ken Watanabe, Elizabeth Olsen, Juliette Binoche, Sally Hawkins (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: The Hangover
programme.desc: Two days before his wedding, Doug (Justin Bartha) and three friends (Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis) drive to Las Vegas for a wild and memorable stag party. In fact, when the three groomsmen wake up the next morning, they can't remember a thing; nor can they find Doug. With little time to spare, the three hazy pals try to re-trace their steps and find Doug so they can get him back to Los Angeles in time to walk down the aisle. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis, Justin Bartha, Heather Graham (Comedy)

programme.title: The Hangover Part II
programme.desc: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis, Justin Bartha, Ken Jeong (Comedy)

programme.title: The Hangover Part III
programme.desc: It's been two years since the gang known as the Wolfpack narrowly escaped disaster in Bangkok. Now, Phil (Bradley Cooper), Stu (Ed Helms) and Doug (Justin Bartha) have happy lives at home -- but Alan (Zach Galifianakis) doesn't. Still lacking contentment and a sense of purpose, Alan has gone off his meds and surrendered to his natural impulses. It's up to the other members of the Wolfpack to get him through his personal crisis by embarking on a road trip to the place it all began: Las Vegas. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis, Justin Bartha, Ken Jeong (Comedy)

programme.title: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
programme.desc: What could possibly go wrong when three buddies (Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan) decide to join the Boy Scouts? When bloodthirsty, undead ghouls invade their once-peaceful town, it's up to kindhearted Ben, quick-witted Carter and class clown Augie to save the day. With help from Denise (Sarah Dumont), a beautiful but tough cocktail waitress, the boys must put their scouting skills to the ultimate test to save mankind and earn their zombie-killing badges. - Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan, Sarah Dumont, David Koechner (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Buddymoon
programme.desc: After he is dumped at the altar, a former child star's best friend takes him on a backpacking trek in the remote mountains of Oregon. - David Giuntoli, Flula Borg, Claire Coffee, Brian T. Finney, Jeanne Syquia (Comedy)

programme.title: Spontaneous
programme.desc: When students in their high school inexplicably start to explode, seniors Mara and Dylan struggle to survive in a world where each moment may be their last. As an unexpected romance blossoms between them, they soon discover that when tomorrow is no longer promised, they can finally start living for today. - Katherine Langford, Charlie Plummer, Yvonne Orji, Hayley Law, Rob Huebel (Dark comedy, Horror, Romance)

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: In the wake of her mother's death in a mental institution, detective Rita Veder (Angela Bassett) is assigned to a baffling serial murder case. After examining the crime scene -- a corpse-filled ship found adrift at sea -- Rita meets Maximilian (Eddie Murphy), a smooth-talking Caribbean playboy determined to romance her. When Rita begins suffering from crippling hallucinations, she calls upon Dr. Zeko (Zakes Mokae), an occultist who suspects a vampire is on the loose. - Eddie Murphy, Angela Bassett, Allen Payne, Kadeem Hardison, John Witherspoon (Comedy, Romance, Fantasy, Horror)

programme.title: Joe Dirt
programme.desc: He's the wrong person, at the wrong place, at the wrong time. Joe Dirt (David Spade) is a janitor with a mullet hairdo, acid-washed jeans and a dream -- to find the parents that he lost at the Grand Canyon when he was eight. As his wandering, misguided search takes him from one misadventure to another, he finds his way to Los Angeles, where a shock-jock (Dennis Miller) brings Joe on the radio to insult him. But as Joe's story unfolds, jeers turn to cheers, and an entire city is captivated. - David Spade, Dennis Miller, Brittany Daniel, Kid Rock, Adam Beach (Comedy)

programme.title: The Ghost and the Darkness
programme.desc: Sir Robert Beaumont (Tom Wilkinson) is behind schedule on a railroad in Africa. Enlisting noted engineer John Henry Patterson (Val Kilmer) to right the ship, Beaumont expects results. Everything seems great until the crew discovers the mutilated corpse of the project's foreman (Henry Cele), seemingly killed by a lion. After several more attacks, Patterson calls in famed hunter Charles Remington (Michael Douglas), who has finally met his match in the bloodthirsty lions. - Michael Douglas, Val Kilmer, Tom Wilkinson, John Kani, Bernard Hill (Historical drama, Adventure, Action, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Changing Lanes
programme.desc: A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost. - Ben Affleck, Samuel L. Jackson, Toni Collette, Sydney Pollack, William Hurt (Thriller, Drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure)

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them. - Shanti Lowry, Sophia Ali, Andrew Howard, Omar Gooding, Dylan Mooney (Thriller)

programme.title: The Crossing Guard
programme.desc: For six excruciating years, Freddy Gale (Jack Nicholson) has fantasized about taking bloody revenge on John Booth (David Morse), the drunk driver responsible for the traffic accident that killed his daughter. On the last day of Booth's prison sentence, a grief-stricken Gale informs his ex-wife, Mary (Anjelica Huston), of his intentions, then follows Booth to a mobile home in the suburbs. There, with hands shaking, Gale draws his gun -- and steps into a dark and uncertain future. - Jack Nicholson, David Morse, Anjelica Huston, Robin Wright, Piper Laurie (Drama)

Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation. - Ron Perlman, Selma Blair, Doug Jones, Jeffrey Tambor, John Hurt (Action, Fantasy, Science fiction)

programme.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Pete (Topher Grace), the quirky, self-deprecating manager of a grocery store, is madly in love with his best friend, Rosalee (Kate Bosworth). Unfortunately, she has absolutely no idea. When Rosalee wins a date with her favorite actor, the smarmy Tad Hamilton (Josh Duhamel), Pete delays admitting his feelings to her. And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. - Kate Bosworth, Topher Grace, Josh Duhamel, Nathan Lane, Sean Hayes (Romance, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Couples Retreat
programme.desc: Four couples, all friends, descend on a tropical island resort. Though one husband and wife are there to work on their marriage, the others just want to enjoy some fun in the sun. They soon find out that the paradise comes at a price, participation in couples therapy sessions is mandatory. What started out as a cut-rate vacation turns into an examination of the common problems many face. - Vince Vaughn, Jason Bateman, Jon Favreau, Faizon Love, Kristin Davis (Comedy)

programme.title: Motives
programme.desc: A successful businessman (Shemar Moore) gets caught in a web of deceit after cheating on his wife (Vivica A. Fox). - Vivica A. Fox, Shemar Moore, Golden Brooks, Sean Blakemore, Joe Torry (Thriller)

programme.title: Motives 2: Retribution
programme.desc: A man (Brian J. White) cuts through lies and deceit to investigate the murder of his imprisoned brother (Shemar Moore). - Brian J. White, Vivica A. Fox, Sean Blakemore, Shemar Moore, Sharon Leal (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: NCIS - Semper Fidelis
programme.desc: S6E24 - Gibbs and the team must work with ICE and FBI agents when a security breach results in the death of an ICE agent; Tony comes face to face with Michael Rivkin (Merik Tadros).

programme.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes - Absorb Attention
programme.desc: S1E1 - At North Port High School in Florida, three students die within months of each other; as the community learns more, they discover a common thread: all three students were hypnotized by their principal, Dr. George Kenney, not long before they died.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes - Bypass the Critical
programme.desc: S1E2 - Dr. George Kenney begins to reveal his side of the story; as details emerge about the deaths and Marcus, Wesley and Brittany's parents speak out, an investigation into Kenney's hypnosis practice begins; the North Port community grows suspicious.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes - Activate the Unconscious
programme.desc: S1E3 - The press catches wind of the story, and it captures headlines worldwide; Dr. Kenney is asked to leave North Port High, and as the criminal trial heats up, the community is split on his culpability; a student comes forward with a new perspective.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes - The Outcome
programme.desc: S1E4 - Pressure mounts against the school board to take accountability; Dr. Kenney leaves North Port for what seems like the final time; the community grapples with guilt and grief; Stephen offers an intimate look into Kenney's hypnosis practice.

programme.title: The A-Team

programme.title: The A-Team - The Children of Jamestown
programme.desc: S1E2 - The rest of the team is caught while Murdock flies a girl to freedom from a religious paramilitary cult; guest John Saxon.

programme.title: The A-Team - Pros and Cons
programme.desc: S1E3 - A boy (Meeno Peluce) whose brother (William Smith) has been unlawfully imprisoned asks his friend B.A. for help; guest Ken Norton.

programme.title: The A-Team - A Small and Deadly War
programme.desc: S1E4 - The team investigates when a SWAT officer suspects his squad of crimes; guests Jack Ging, Dean Stockwell.

programme.title: The A-Team - Black Day at Bad Rock

programme.title: Law & Order
programme.desc: Lives hang in the balance as detectives and prosecutors pursue justice in New York City. In cases ripped from the headlines, police investigate serious and often deadly crimes, weighing the evidence and questioning the suspects until someone is taken into custody. The district attorney's office then builds a case to convict the perpetrator by proving the person guilty beyond a reasonable doubt. Working together, these expert teams navigate all sides of the complex criminal justice system to make New York a safer place -- and keep the worst offenders off the streets. - Hugh Dancy, Odelya Halevi, Tony Goldwyn, Mehcad Brooks, Reid Scott (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Donnie Brasco
programme.desc: Joseph Pistone (Johnny Depp) is an FBI agent who has infiltrated one of the major New York Mafia families and is living under the name Donnie Brasco. He develops a relationship with mob hitman Benjamin "Lefty" Ruggiero (Al Pacino) in order to get deeper under cover, but ends up developing a real friendship with the Mafioso. As their relationship develops, Pistone must decide whether to complete his job, knowing that it will lead to the murder of his new friend. - Al Pacino, Johnny Depp, Michael Madsen, Bruno Kirby, James Russo (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: A Few Good Men
programme.desc: Lt. Daniel Kaffee (Tom Cruise) is a military lawyer defending two U.S. Marines charged with killing a fellow Marine at the Guantánamo Bay Naval Base in Cuba. Although Kaffee is known for seeking plea bargains, a fellow lawyer, Lt. Cdr. JoAnne Galloway (Demi Moore), convinces him that the accused marines were most likely carrying out an order from a commanding officer. Kaffee takes a risk by calling Col. Nathan R. Jessep (Jack Nicholson) to the stand in an effort to uncover the conspiracy. - Tom Cruise, Jack Nicholson, Demi Moore, Kevin Bacon, Kiefer Sutherland (Drama)

programme.title: Coach
programme.desc: Hayden Fox is a football coach, the head coach of Minnesota State University's Screaming Eagles for much of the series' run. He has to contend with a team that has seen better days, a couple of none-too-bright assistant coaches, a partner who isn't half as obsessed with football, and all the rest of the situations that come along in Big Ten athletics. For the show's final two seasons, Fox coaches an expansion team in the NFL. - Craig T. Nelson, Jerry Van Dyke, Shelley Fabares, Clare Carey, Bill Fagerbakke (Sitcom)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Mission PAW: Pups Save the Royal Throne
programme.desc: S4E10 - The pups must come to the rescue when Sweetie plans to steal the royal throne so that she can rule.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - All-Star Pups!; Pups Save Sports Day
programme.desc: S3E17 - The pups play kickball against Raimondo's team, until an eagle steals the ball; the All-Star pups are ready to compete in the summer sports day when Daring Danny X turns the field into an ice rink.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Treats; Pups Get a Lift
programme.desc: S1E9 - Mr. Porter's van full of puppy food and treats slides on the ice; the PAW Patrol comes to the rescue when Katie and her cat are trapped on a ski lift.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Royal Kitties
programme.desc: S5E11 - When the Royal Kitties are kidnapped on their way to Adventure Bay for a special visit, Ryder needs all the pups to help Chase investigate the case.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Fire Rescue: Pups Save Lizzy's Lemonade Blaze
programme.desc: S11E21 - Mayor Humdinger and his kitties accidentally set Lizzy's Lemonade Stand and parts of Foggy Bottom ablaze; it's up to the pups to extinguish the fires.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Hum-nata; Pups Stop the Foggy Skies
programme.desc: S10E12 - Mayor Humdinger's birthday party goes horribly awry when Marshall Kitty gets trapped inside a life-sized piñata; Mayor Humdinger tries pushing fog into Adventure Bay, it's up to the PAW Patrol to find animals missing in the clouds and save the day.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Space Kitty; Pups Save the Sea Sponges
programme.desc: S11E26 - When Humdinger puts on a cat costume, the Alien Kid mistakes him for a real kitty in need of a home and beams Humdinger into his UFO; after a tiring deep-sea dive, Zuma dozes off and dreams about the life he might have.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Butterflies; Pups Save an Underground Chicken
programme.desc: S5E7 - Chickaletta is stuck on a runaway drone and mysterious butterflies cause chaos all around Adventure Bay; Mayor Humdinger steals the statue of Chickaletta.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Playground; The Crew Fixes a Roof
programme.desc: S1E4 - After Speed Meister builds an unsafe playground, Rubble & Crew get creative and build a new one with old materials; the town Chili Cookaroo is threatened when City Hall's roof starts to cave in; luckily, the pups know just how to fix it.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds an Observatory; The Crew Builds a Zipline
programme.desc: S1E16 - The pups jump into action to build an observatory to help their friend River get a cool picture of a shooting star; after meeting Park Ranger Rose, the pups get stuck on a nature trail, but with Rubble & Crew, there's always a solution.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Rescue Knights: Pups Save a Tournament; Rescue Knights: Pups Save the Baby Dragons
programme.desc: S8E19 - The PAW Patrol helps a Mystery Knight and the Princess in disguise win a tournament when Claw and Sparks show up to sabotage the event; the Rescue Knights must save some baby dragons from Claw and reunite them with their mommy.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Runaway Kitties; Pups Save Tiny Marshall
programme.desc: S4E14 - The Kit-trastrophe crew gets into the poufy shampoo, and they are blown away; Marshall dreams he gets shrunk.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Get Growing; Pups Save a Space Toy
programme.desc: S3E19 - When Yumi's crops begin to sprout huge vegetables, the PAW Patrol must corral the stampeding produce; the pups draw a message for space aliens on Farmer Al's field.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Marooned Mayors; Pups Save the Game Show
programme.desc: S7E15 - While ice fishing in the North Country, Mayor Goodway and Mayor Humdinger get stuck in an ice crevasse; Beryl hosts a game show at the Wingnuts' farm.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Moto Pups: Pups vs. the Ruff-Ruff Pack
programme.desc: S7E20 - Stunt motorcyclist Wild Cat joins the patrol to try to keep Ruff-Ruff Pack troublemakers from trashing the town.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups and the Power of Flowers; Pups Save the Alien Egg Hunt
programme.desc: S11E20 - A jealous Mayor Humdinger tries to swipe the florist's Easter decorations and winds up on a runaway wagon with Mayor Goodway; mysterious Alien Easter Eggs cause trouble in Adventure Bay.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Taste Buddies!
programme.desc: S5E26 - When Chefs Molly and Gil bring their tasty food truck to Bland Land, they discover that Baron von Bland only lets his subjects eat Bland Bread; the Chefs must find a way to bring taste to the kingdom.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Kingdom of Sleepwell!
programme.desc: S6E11 - All is not well in the normally well-rested Kingdom of Sleepwell because Princess Deema can't fall asleep; her royal court comes to her aid, but even magic doesn't work.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - A Royal Mess
programme.desc: S5E3 - Dirty Deema steals Molly and Gil's soap and makes the Kingdom of Clean very dirty; Molly and Gil have to get their soap back and clean up the kingdom.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Taste Buddies!
programme.desc: S5E26 - When Chefs Molly and Gil bring their tasty food truck to Bland Land, they discover that Baron von Bland only lets his subjects eat Bland Bread; the Chefs must find a way to bring taste to the kingdom.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Kingdom of Sleepwell!
programme.desc: S6E11 - All is not well in the normally well-rested Kingdom of Sleepwell because Princess Deema can't fall asleep; her royal court comes to her aid, but even magic doesn't work.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The New Guppy!
programme.desc: S5E1 - The Sea Witch steals the Guppies' magical jewels so she can rule the Seven Seas; the Guppies must get their jewels back and stop her before it's too late.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Come to Your Senses!
programme.desc: S3E14 - When Nonny breaks his glasses, he must use his other senses to reach the glasses store.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Zooli's New Pet!
programme.desc: S6E22 - Excited that Zooli is getting a new pet, the Guppies try to guess what kind of animal it is; Zooli loves many creatures, so her new pet could be anything in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Ducks in a Row
programme.desc: S1E5 - Nonnie must figure out how to lead the marching band when a duck gets in its way.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Three Guppeteers!
programme.desc: S6E24 - When a Gargoyle steals all the gifts and decorations for Countess Molly's surprise party, the French villagers call in the Three Guppeteers.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Mighty, Untidy Titans!
programme.desc: S5E15 - When some untidy Titans (played by Guppies) start messing up Zooli, Nonny and Oona's goat farm, the goat herders must journey to the Titans' cloud realm to ask them to tidy up.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The SS Friendship!
programme.desc: S6E6 - Capt. Deema and first mate Gil pilot their steampunk sub to different ocean habitats so they can deliver Friendship Day bubblegrams to all their friends; along the way, they find themselves being chased by a kraken.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Cowgirl Parade!
programme.desc: S2E6 - Molly wants to be a cowgirl like Dusty.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Call a Clambulance
programme.desc: S1E1 - Oona's friend must visit a doctor when he breaks a bone in his tail.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - My Cousin Chloe; Shopping; At the Beach; Secrets; The Museum
programme.desc: Peppa's cousin comes to visit; the family goes to the supermarket; Peppa and George enjoy the beach; Mummy Pig makes Peppa a special box; Peppa and her family visit the museum.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Danny's Pirate Party; The Train Ride; Teddy Playgroup; A Trip to the Moon; Numbers
programme.desc: Danny Dog's birthday arrives; Peppa and her friends go on a train ride; Peppa brings home a teddy; Peppa's family goes to a Moon Exhibition; Peppa and her friends learn how to count.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Strawberries; Pizza! Pizza!; Grandpa Pig's Birthday; Pancakes; Teddy's Day Out
programme.desc: Grandpa and Granny Pig have been growing strawberries; Peppa and family make pizzas; Peppa and her family celebrate Grandpa Pig's birthday; Daddy Pig thinks he's an expert pancake maker; Peppa loses Teddy at a picnic.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy's Dinosaur Park; George's New Dinosaur; Captain Daddy Dog; Kylie Kangaroo; The Pet Competition
programme.desc: The children take a trip to Dinosaur Park; George visits Mr. Fox's shop; Captain Daddy Dog returns from sea bearing gifts; Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother; everyone brings their pets to a competition.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Big Truck Pups Save the Swiped Speakers; Big Truck Pups Save the Big Big Pipes
programme.desc: S9E11 - When Mayor Humdinger hijacks Al's big rig carrying Luke Stars and his concert equipment, it's up to the pups to rescue him; when Al's load of pipes breaks loose, it's up to the pups to save their friends from the rolling hazards.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Save a Giant Chicken; Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Stop Harold's Deep Freeze
programme.desc: S6E15 - The Mighty Twins join the Mighty Pups to save a giant chicken and the town; the Mighty Pups have to stop Harold Humdinger before he puts Adventure Bay in a deep freeze so he can become mayor.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Bowling Alley; The Crew Builds a Superbloom Path
programme.desc: S2E16 - Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play and build whatever the community needs.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Blimp; Pups Save a Chili Cook-Off
programme.desc: S4E1 - Cap'n Turbot's weather blimp is taken by Mayor Humdinger, who plans to use it to change the weather in Foggy Bottom; Mr. Porter's stove explodes right before the chili cook-off.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines - The Race Around the Earth
programme.desc: S5E17 - Blaze and AJ go head-to-head against Crusher to race all the way around the Earth.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas - Lorelai's Bracelet; Cecilia and the Ghost Ship
programme.desc: S1E10 - Bonnie turns into a mermaid; Santi and the crew face shenanigans trying to rescue Cecilia from the Ghost Ship.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save Daring Danny X; Pups in a Fix
programme.desc: S3E8 - Ryder performs an incredible stunt during a rescue, inspiring a young boy to become a daredevil; Ryder entrusts the care of Adventure Bay to Robo-Dog while he and the pups take a vacation.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save Alex's Mini-Patrol; Pups Save a Lost Tooth
programme.desc: S3E4 - Alex sets up his own mini-patrol, recruiting Chickaletta, Cali, Turtle, and Bunny; Alex loses his first tooth and then misplaces it.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups in a Jam; Pups Save a Windsurfing Pig
programme.desc: S3E18 - All the fruit at the annual Jamboree Jamfest is carried off by ants; Zuma goes on a wacky water rescue after Cornelius the pig goes for a ride on a windsurfing board.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Sea Patrol: Pirate Pups to the Rescue
programme.desc: S4E19 - Carlos and Tracker are stranded on an island while searching for buried treasure.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew and Marshall Build a Fire Watch Tower
programme.desc: S5E8 - Marshall from "Paw Patrol" keeps watch for Fire Captain Catáwi on his day off; but when Speed Meister accidentally sparks embers that could start a fire, Marshall teams up with the pups and Catáwi to save Builder Cove!

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Runaway Robo-Chicken Purse; Pups Save the Buggy Trekkers
programme.desc: S10E24 - Digi and Tal's inventions to help a busy Mayor Goodway go haywire and lead to a wild woodland chase; when Mayor Humdinger squeezes himself into the Trekkers' friendly dune buggy race, his cheating ways put the other racers in jeopardy.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - The Children's Fete; Fruit; The Aquarium; The Fish Pond; Pedro Is Late
programme.desc: The children organize a party to raise money for a new roof; Miss Rabbit makes fruit smoothies; Peppa takes Goldie to the aquarium; Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to see a fishpond; Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit are stranded on a desert island. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Made Up Musical Instruments; Butterflies; The Botanical Gardens; Viking Day; Mr. Potato's Quiz

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy's Dinosaur Park; George's New Dinosaur; Captain Daddy Dog; Kylie Kangaroo; The Pet Competition

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Manatee; Pups Save Breakfast
programme.desc: S6E10 - Farmer Al and Farmer Yumi need help from the PAW Patrol to get a manatee to the swamp; Mr. Porter and Alex get into a sticky situation involving maple syrup. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Comedy)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Windswept Polar Bear Cub; Pups Save a Drive-In
programme.desc: S10E4 - When a windstorm sends a polar bear cub down to Adventure Bay, it's up to Ryder, Everest, and the pups to bring the baby bear back to its family; the pups must save Mayor Humdinger from a runaway movie projector. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Pluck-O-Matic; Pups Save a Mascot
programme.desc: S5E24 - Yumi's new Robo-Corn Plucker goes haywire; Ryder and the "PAW Patrol" must get it under control; Daring Danny X, dressed as a "Bird X" mascot, gets carried away by a couple of eagles. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Sea Patrol: Pups Save the Pirated Sea Patroller
programme.desc: S5E9 - Sid the Pirate and Arrby steal the Ferris wheel; when the pups set out to bring it back to Adventure Bay, Sid comes up with a sneaky plan to steal the Sea Patroller. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Wacky Water Skiers; Pups Save the Mayor's Assistant
programme.desc: S10E1 - When Emmy and Eddie take a joyride, Hurricane Harrigan and Cap'n Turbot get caught water-skiing behind the out-of-control boat. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Aqua Pups Save the Reef; Aqua Pups Stop a Giant Squid

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Beaver Home; The Crew Fixes a Road
programme.desc: S1E7 - When the pups find out a beaver is to blame for the power being out, they build it a new home to bring the power back. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds Charger a Super Bed; The Crew Builds a Super Squirrely Whirly Playground

(Baseball)

MLB Network's signature program, "MLB Tonight" presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast. The Emmy-winning studio show features highlights, live look-ins and breaking news, plus analysis from a rotating roster of hosts, former players and inside information men. (Baseball)

programme.title: Quick Pitch
programme.desc: Sometimes, fans of America's national pastime might miss a day or two of their favorite sport due to pesky things like work, a wedding anniversary, or a child's high-school graduation ceremony. Rest easy, devotees of the diamond -- MLB Network has you covered. "Quick Pitch" not only provides complete highlights of each game from the previous day, but also presents a glimpse at upcoming contests, including pitching matchups. (Baseball)

programme.title: The Leadoff Spot (Live)
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel. (Sports talk, Talk)

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Baseball (Live)
programme.desc: Major League Baseball. (Classic sport event, Baseball)

programme.title: Intentional Talk (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

After one such scam, a mysterious man called Cavaldi brings them to a French general, who persuades them to battle the evil that has kidnapped 10 girls from a small village. During the investigation, the cynical Wilhelm and sensitive Jacob see things that point to real magic at work. - Matt Damon, Heath Ledger, Peter Stormare, Lena Headey, Jonathan Pryce (Fantasy, Adventure, Mystery, Thriller)

In the process, two of Kirk's officers are captured by Khan (Ricardo Montalban), an enemy Kirk thought he'd never see again. Once more, Kirk takes the Enterprise's helm, where he meets Khan's ship in an intergalactic showdown. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Ricardo Montalban, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Drama, Thriller)

With help from their new friends, the crime-fighting duo must now foil another kidnapping plot and rescue other valuable animals from a gang of greedy smugglers. - Will Arnett, Natasha Lyonne, RuPaul, Omar Chaparro, Andy Beckwith (Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles

So when strange things happen after his family's move to a relative's dilapidated estate, sister Mallory, twin brother Simon and their mother assume that Jared is behind it all. However, magical creatures roam the grounds, and they all want a special book that Jared has found: a field guide to fantastic creatures, penned by Arthur Spiderwick. - Freddie Highmore, Sarah Bolger, Mary-Louise Parker, David Strathairn, Joan Plowright (Children, Fantasy, Adventure, Drama, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo. - Harrison Ford, Karen Allen, Paul Freeman, Wolf Kahler, Ronald Lacey (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a nightclub singer and a 12-year-old boy. - Harrison Ford, Kate Capshaw, Ke Huy Quan, Amrish Puri, Roshan Seth (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: An art collector appeals to Jones to embark on a search for the Holy Grail. He learns that another archaeologist has disappeared while searching for the precious goblet, and the missing man is his own father, Dr. Henry Jones. The artifact is much harder to find than they expected, and its powers are too much for those impure in heart. - Harrison Ford, Sean Connery, Denholm Elliott, Alison Doody, John Rhys-Davies (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world. - Harrison Ford, Cate Blanchett, Shia La Beouf, Karen Allen, Ray Winstone (Family, Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too. - Harrison Ford, Julia Ormond, Greg Kinnear, Nancy Marchand, John Wood (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Regarding Henry

After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends. - Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen, Donald Moffat (Drama)

programme.title: Three Wishes

programme.title: Carriers

programme.desc: A psychology student (Laura Regan) and her friends begin to have nightmares, resulting in strange marks appearing on their bodies.

programme.title: Marshmallow

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: A widowed lawyer (Daniel Radcliffe) encounters ghostly goings-on at the foreboding estate of a recently deceased client.

programme.title: Good Kill
programme.desc: An Air Force drone pilot (Ethan Hawke) begins to question the ethics of dropping bombs on Afghanistan from the safety of his post in Las Vegas. - Ethan Hawke, January Jones, Bruce Greenwood, Zoë Kravitz, Jake Abel (War, Drama)

programme.title: Fight or Flight
programme.desc: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. programme.title: The Seven Five
programme.desc: Former NYPD officer Michael Dowd tells how he and his partner committed a long list of crimes, including running their own cocaine ring, while on the job in the 1980s and early '90s. (Documentary, Biography)

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents. - Rod Steiger, Jeff Saumier, Ray Aranha, Mark Camacho, Jane Wheeler (Drama)

programme.title: Our Friend
programme.desc: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home. - Jason Segel, Dakota Johnson, Casey Affleck, Isabella Kai Rice, Violet McGraw (Drama)

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Never Say Never
programme.desc: A young singing sensation prepares to dazzle the crowd at a sold-out show at Madison Square Garden. Legions of adoring Bieber fans scream as he takes center stage for a memorable night of music. Concert footage mixes with home videos of Justin playing drums and showcasing his talent. - Boyz II Men (Documentary)

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. - Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand, Kate Hudson, Jason Lee, Patrick Fugit (Comedy drama, Music, Rock, Drama)

programme.title: Bleed for This
programme.desc: Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story. - Miles Teller, Aaron Eckhart, Katey Sagal, Ciarán Hinds, Ted Levine (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Average Joe's Gym and its owner, Peter La Fleur (Vince Vaughn), are both down on their luck. A fancy competing gym called Globo-Gym, run by the maniacal health nut White Goodman (Ben Stiller), is about to put Average Joe's out of business unless Peter can raise $50,000 to keep his mortgage. To save the gym, Peter and a ragtag group of Average Joe's members and employees enter a dodgeball contest with a big cash prize. In response, White forms his own Globo-Gym team to rout the competition. - Vince Vaughn, Christine Taylor, Ben Stiller, Rip Torn, Justin Long (Comedy)

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. - Ansel Elgort, Kevin Spacey, Lily James, Jon Bernthal, Jon Hamm (Action, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface. - Elisabeth Moss, Kate Hudson, Arian Moayed, Este Haim, Elizabeth Berkley (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Vicious
programme.desc: Polly receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love. What begins as a strange ritual quickly unravels into a waking nightmare as she becomes trapped in a terrifying world where reality bends and memory betrays. As time slips away, she must confront the darkness not just around her, but within her, before it consumes everything and everyone she's ever known. - Dakota Fanning, Kathryn Hunter, Mary McCormack, Rachel Blanchard, Devyn Nekoda (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when then they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life in an idyllic and remote lakeside farmhouse. Still traumatized, their physical and mental well-being are pushed to the limit as their fragile existence is threatened. - Christina Ricci, Colleen Camp, Lew Temple, Nick Vallelonga, Santino Barnard (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Doin' It
programme.desc: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. - Lilly Singh, Sonia Dhillon Tully, Sabrina Jalees, Ana Gasteyer, Stephanie Beatriz (Comedy)

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love. - Kristen Stewart, Steven Yeun (Romance, Science fiction, Drama)

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt. - Alexandra Grey, David Beck, Jacob Moran, Hudson Paul, Fiona Morgan Quinn (Drama, Comedy)

As Daniel navigates his way through an agonizing appeal process, he begins to develop a strong bond with a destitute, single mother (Hayley Squires) who's struggling to take care of her two children. - Dave Johns, Hayley Squires, Dylan McKiernan, Briana Shann, Kate Rutter (Drama)

programme.title: Wakefield

When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. - Bryan Cranston, Jennifer Garner, Jason O'Mara, Beverly D'Angelo, Ian Anthony Dale (Drama)

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy)

The friends often end up having to pay for their irresponsible actions as they usually get into more trouble than they anticipated. Their slacking off at work causes much chagrin for their hot-tempered gumball machine boss, Benson. (Animated, Children, Dark comedy, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: We Bare Bears
programme.desc: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends, or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. - Elizabeth Banks, Emily Browning, Arielle Kebbel, David Strathairn, Jesse Moss (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery)

programme.title: House at the End of the Street
programme.desc: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery. - Jennifer Lawrence, Max Thieriot, Elisabeth Shue, Gil Bellows, Eva Link (Thriller, Horror)

programme.title: Haunter
programme.desc: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living. - Abigail Breslin, Stephen McHattie, Peter Outerbridge, Michelle Nolden, David Hewlett (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Sweetness
programme.desc: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love. - Kate Hallett, Herman Tømmeraas, Aya Furukawa, Justin Chatwin, Steven Ogg (Thriller)

programme.title: Blindness
programme.desc: When an epidemic of a disease known as the "white sickness" appears in her city, the wife (Julianne Moore) of a doctor is one of the few individuals left who still has sight. Sent to a government asylum along with her now-blind husband (Mark Ruffalo), she sees conditions deteriorate until civilization itself is in jeopardy, prompting her break-out of the asylum to lead a small group to freedom. - Julianne Moore, Mark Ruffalo, Alice Braga, Yusuke Iseya, Yoshino Kimura (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: Amy (Jena Malone), Stacy (Laura Ramsey), Jeff (Jonathan Tucker) and Eric (Shawn Ashmore) look for fun during a sunny holiday in Mexico, but they get much more than that after visiting an archaeological dig in the jungle. Carnivorous vines try to ensnare the friends in their tendrils, forcing the group to fight for survival. - Jonathan Tucker, Jena Malone, Laura Ramsey, Shawn Ashmore, Joe Anderson (Horror, Thriller, Adventure, Action, Mystery)

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents. - Angelina Jolie, Gerard Butler, Ciarán Hinds, Christopher Barrie, Noah Taylor (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: This horror tale focuses on visitors to the secluded mansion of Hill House who have been called to the isolated location by Dr. David Marrow (Liam Neeson) as part of a study on insomnia. However, Marrow is really investigating fear, and he plans to scare the subjects, including the introverted Nell (Lili Taylor) and the seductive Theo (Catherine Zeta-Jones). Unfortunately for Marrow and everyone staying at Hill House, the manor is actually haunted by an evil spirit out to torment its guests. - Liam Neeson, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Owen Wilson, Lili Taylor, Bruce Dern (Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Mystery)

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery. - Naomi Watts, Martin Henderson, David Dorfman, Brian Cox, Jane Alexander (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next. - Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat, Brian Boland, Molly Ephraim, Sprague Grayden (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: In the tiny town of Brixton, Georgia where nothing is private, a woman with supernatural clairvoyance, a young beautiful socialite who has mysteriously disappeared, and an assortment of colorful characters all collide. A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit. - Cate Blanchett, Giovanni Ribisi, Keanu Reeves, Katie Holmes, Greg Kinnear (Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud. - Marisa Tomei, Sherry Cola, Ciara Bravo, Marco Pigossi, José María Yazpik (Romantic comedy)
